(1) Admissibility reduction verified: offsets mod2={0}, mod3={0,1} forcing p=1(3), mod5={0,1,2,4} forcing p=2(5); CRT gives unique p=7(30) for p>5; pairwise differences {2,4,6,8,10,12,16} contain no multiple of 7,11,13 and are <q for q>=17, so exactly 6 forbidden residues for every q>5 (checked q=7,11,13,17 give w=6). Candidate count 33333333 verified closed-form. (2) Completeness proven by exhaustive enumeration: recompiled sieve_census.c (odd-only) and sieve_recount.c (wheel-30 with 6-residue marking + trial confirm) and reran deterministically: both N=42, byte-identical lists, SHA-256 39af0f3429c36116648d85c84fe027e172ee777f006c73f47561a87cedd4ce75 matching archived census.json/recount.json; cross-diff identical; sorted, in-interval, all =7(30), gaps min 1516200/max 77119770. Overhang p+16>=R handled by trial division (at most 16/segment); small-range discrepancy (recount marks p+o==q as composite) provably vacuous in I since q<=1000500<<1e12. Third-method independent Python trial-division brute on three 1-2M windows ([1000033000000,1000034000000]->1 tuple, [1000200000000,1000203000000]->2 tuples, tail 2M->0, head 1M->0) matches census subsets exactly. (3) Primality proven: independent stdlib deterministic Miller-Rabin with bases {2,325,9375,28178,450775,9780504,1795265022} (Jaeschke-Sorenson-Webster, deterministic for <2^64) gives 252/252 prime, 0 fails; pratt_verify.py (pow-only) gives 252/252 PASS; 5 random certs deep-checked: product r^e==q-1, g^(q-1)==1, g^((q-1)/r)!=1, residual factorization after trial to 1e6 matches cert remainder; generation uses trial to 1000500 (complete since sqrt(HI+16)~1000500), so DRAFT 'to 1e6' shorthand is immaterial. Decimals: 252/252 13-digit string round-trip. (4) HL comparison correctly presented as heuristic check, not proof: independent product to 50k gives C~17.29905 vs claimed 17.29860 (diff 0.0004, tail <1e-6), pred ~38.87 vs 42 ratio 1.08 Poisson p~0.33, agreement within noise. No essential inference, boundary, or computation error found.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors compared substantively: (a) OEIS A022008 initial members + b-file (dense small terms, no MR transcripts/Pratt certs, dense coverage per triage far below 1e12; embedded head [7,97,16057,19417] verified 0/42 overlap, all 42 >=1e12 13-digit); (b) Wikipedia Prime k-tuple (definition, small examples e.g. 7,11,13,17,19,23, largest-known hundreds/thousands-digit size records, no dense 1e12+1e9 census); (c) Forbes/Nicely/PrimePages/primeconstellation.dk/t5k constellation tables (sporadic large records, counts to bounds, HL constants, primesieve methodology, no Pratt-certified complete list for this window with double-sieve agreement + miss table). Pattern, segmented sieve, 7-base MR, Pratt method are all standard and explicitly disclaimed; delta is certified closure of this stated 1e9 window (completeness + 252 certs + miss/HL context), not another digit-size record and not a pattern change. In narrow packaging sense no prior dense Pratt-certified census for exactly this I was found, so PASS. Crucially, live line-by-line b-file/Wikipedia/constellation diff was NOT performed (HTTPS fails both in candidate logs and in this audit: OEIS, Wikipedia, t5k all Transport/SSLEOF errors), so least-absent-from-tables priority rests on range argument + offline triage truncation claim, honestly qualified as conditional in DRAFT sects 1 and 5. A failed search does not establish priority; residual risk that a local b022008.txt extending beyond 1e12 could overlap remains (estimated unlikely: HL predicts ~39k tuples below 1e12, typical b-files ~10k terms stop well below 1e12, but unverified).

value.rationale: Even though correct and narrowly new, the result as stated is not independently worth finding later. It is a textbook pattern at an arbitrary round-number interval with only routine computation: (i) Pattern S(p) minimal-diameter claim and p=7(30) filter are 2-line CRT exercises; (ii) Interval [1e12,1e12+1e9] is decimal-round, not mathematically distinguished (not a maximal gap, not a new limit, not a community-requested benchmark gap, not a counterexample); any 1e9 window has a trivial least-in-I if non-empty, conflated here with first-occurrence record while explicitly disclaiming maximal-digit record; (iii) Computation is trivially recomputable: 0.74s + 1.84s sieves, <10s total on laptop with standard C/Python, so archival value is nil; (iv) No surprise or consequence: observed 42 vs HL 38.87 ratio 1.08 Poisson p=0.33 (<0.6 sigma) is exactly null result, no anomaly, no new conjecture, no refutation, no method advance; (v) Certificates are credential inflation: deterministic MR already proves 13-digit primality in <1ms; 252 Pratt certs add files but no insight; (vi) Miss histogram (5-of-6 uniform within noise, as expected) and HL product are perfunctory byproducts, explicitly without finding. This is precisely mere parameter substitution (same classical 6-tuple at larger bound) plus unexplained enumeration (list of 42 positions with no structure revealed) with generic add-ons that could be attached to any interval. Per scope rule, such enumerations are rejected even if correct and new.
